plain.name: The Norwegian weather service
plain.gives: Forecasts, nowcasts, sunrise and moon times, air quality, and weather warnings for any place, from the institute behind Yr.
plain.cadence: Hourly forecasts, nowcasts every five minutes.
plain.asks: Nothing until you build a tile from it.

attribution: Weather data from MET Norway, licensed CC BY 4.0

terms.note: Free with attribution; every request must identify the app in the User-Agent header; at most one request per place every ten minutes.
